#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istringstream tokenizer;
    string buffer;

    InputReader() {
        buffer.reserve(32768);
    }

    string next() {
        while (!(tokenizer >> buffer)) {
            if (!getline(cin, buffer))
                throw runtime_error("End of input");
            stringstream ss(buffer);
            tokenizer = move(ss);
        }
        return buffer;
    }

    int NextInt() {
        int val;
        string token = next();
        val = stoi(token);
        return val;
    }

    long long NextLong() {
        long long val;
        string token = next();
        val = stoll(token);
        return val;
    }
};

class GTakeMetro {
public:
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;

    void step() {
        int curJump = static_cast<int>(t-- % n);
        int sign = (s < m) ? 1 : -1;
        s += sign * curJump;
        s %= n;
        if (s < 0) s += n;
    }

    void doLoop() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            step();
        }
    }

    void solve() {
        InputReader in;
        n = in.NextInt();
        m = in.NextInt();
        s = in.NextInt() - 1;
        t = in.NextLong();

        while ((t % n) != 0) {
            step();
        }

        vector<long long> lastSeem(n, -1);
        while (t != 0) {
            doLoop();
            if (lastSeem[s] != -1) {
                long long interval = lastSeem[s] - t;
                t %= interval;
                break;
            } else {
                lastSeem[s] = t;
            }
        }
        while (t != 0) {
            step();
        }
        cout << s + 1 << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    GTakeMetro solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
